The '''56th Golden Globe Awards''' honored the best in [[1998 in film|film]] and [[1998 in American television|television of 1998]] as chosen by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association|HFPA]], were held on January 24, 1999, at the [[Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills]], California. The ceremony was produced by [[Dick Clark Productions]] and the HFPA and aired on [[NBC]] in the United States.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Higgins|first1=Bill|title=Globes 'In Love' and war|url=https://variety.com/1999/film/news/globes-in-love-and-war-1117490584/|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Variety|date=24 January 1999}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Welkos|first1=Robert|last2=King|first2=Susan|title=All's Fair in 'Love' and War|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1999-jan-25-ca-1528-story.html|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=25 January 1999}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Lister|first1=David|title=Caine leads British charge at Golden Globes|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/caine-leads-british-charge-at-golden-globes-1076355.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121110121445/http://www.independent.co.uk/news/caine-leads-british-charge-at-golden-globes-1076355.html |archive-date=2012-11-10 |url-access=limited |url-status=live|access-date=11 January 2018|work=The Independent|date=26 January 1999}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Karger|first1=Dave|last2=Laine|first2=Tricia|title=The Golden Globe winners|url=http://ew.com/article/1999/02/05/golden-globe-winners/|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Entertainment Weekly|date=5 February 1999}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 17, 1998.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Higgins|first1=Bill|last2=Hontz|first2=Jenny|title=‘Truman,’ Bard win noms|url=https://variety.com/1998/film/news/truman-bard-win-noms-1117489548/|access-date=11 January 2018|work=Variety|date=16 December 1998}}</ref>
